_README: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Not real R&D records. Every project, formula,
requirement, test target and person below is invented.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS, AND WHY IT IS JSON RATHER THAN CODE.
It is read by TWO consumers: scripts/seed.py, which loads it into
PostgreSQL, and apps/web/lib/demo/dataset.ts, which bakes it into the
static export so the deployed demo site has something to show without
an API. Those two had to agree. Keeping a Python list and a TypeScript
list in step by hand is the exact failure this repository keeps
hitting -- two literals in two files that nothing can check against
each other -- so there is one file and both read it.
THE SHAPES MIRROR THE REAL API CONTRACT (app/api/projects.py,
tasks.py, opportunities.py, admin_stage_gates.py). That is deliberate:
when the API is wired in at a later slice, the frontend swaps its data
source without reshaping a single component. Demo data in a different
shape from the real thing would guarantee a rewrite.
ADR-009 scopes the Render deployment to demo staging that must never
hold real R&D records. Baking THIS data in is consistent with that:
there is nothing confidential here to leak.
Dates are fixed literals, never generated. A dataset that shifts with
the build clock makes two builds incomparable and makes a snapshot
test impossible to write.

NOTE: requirements carry NO stored verification status. The state is derived from measured_value against minimum/maximum and warning_threshold, because CLAUDE.md section 10 requires it to be computed and never a field anyone sets. A stored `result` column was removed for exactly that reason -- it could disagree with the measurement beside it, and did.

Warning bands are TWO fields, warning_minimum and warning_maximum, not one shared threshold. A requirement with both a minimum and a maximum cannot express its warning band with a single number -- every reading except that exact value would land inside one side of the band.
stages carry normal_path. FAILURE_REWORK is false: it is entered only on a critical failure, so including it in a progress denominator makes a healthy project permanently incomplete.

materials, suppliers and formulas are Slice 3. Every DERIVED figure on a formula version lives under `computed` and is produced by scripts/build_demo_formulations.py running app.calculations.formulation -- the real engine. Nothing in TypeScript performs formulation arithmetic; CLAUDE.md rule 2 gives that to Python and a second implementation in the frontend would be that rule broken on purpose.

versions.change_reason: Baseline from the existing production putty.
versions.technical_hypothesis: Establish a reference before any lightweighting.
versions.expected_effect: Matches incumbent density and sanding time.
versions.observed_effect: Density 1.62 g/cm3 — far above the 1.25 maximum, as expected.

versions.change_reason: Introduce hollow microspheres to attack density.
versions.technical_hypothesis: Replacing carbonate with microspheres lowers density more than proportionally, because the spheres displace volume at a seventh of the mass.
versions.observed_effect: 1.36 g/cm3. Still short of target; sanding improved.

versions.change_reason: Move to low-styrene resin and raise microsphere loading.
versions.technical_hypothesis: Low-styrene resin cuts VOC without hurting cure; the extra microspheres carry density down further.
versions.observed_effect: Measured density 1.24 g/cm3 against a theoretical 1.16 — the gap is microsphere breakage under high-shear dispersion, which the volume-additive model cannot see. Adhesion to aluminium fell to 6.1 MPa, below the 6.5 minimum.

versions.change_reason: Restore adhesion by raising the silane and trimming carbonate.
versions.technical_hypothesis: Silane at 1% couples the resin to the aluminium oxide layer; removing 2% carbonate keeps density in band.
versions.expected_effect: Adhesion back above 6.5 MPa with density held under 1.25.
versions.observed_effect: Measured density 1.19 g/cm3 against a theoretical 1.09, the same breakage gap as V003. Adhesion recovered to 6.8 MPa. Both requirements in tolerance; adhesion on a low margin.

versions.change_reason: Trial free styrene to cut viscosity for the 5 C sanding failure.
versions.technical_hypothesis: Thinning the wet paste should shorten low-temperature sanding time.
versions.expected_effect: 5 C sanding below the 40 minute maximum.
